message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"extractFile","explanation":"In extractFile, the untrusted archive entry name (entryName) from ZipEntry.getName() flows through FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) into the File f, which is then passed to the FileOutputStream(File) sink. There is no containment check or allow-list comparing the resolved path to the destination directory, so absolute paths or ../ traversal in the entry name can write outside dir."}]}
